name: Xavier
source:
He/Him

Works at the coffee shop part time while going to the nearby University of Jefferson. He is the youngest of the 3 core coffee shop employees but is the best at his job out of all of them. He is a very selfless person and cares deeply about the people around him. He is a hard worker, maintains strong morals, and will not use drugs or drink.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
